correctness.rationale: The digit-paired carry NFA exactly represents sums, determinization counts output integers once, the 37-state exhaustive reachability certificate gives A_m=vM^(m-1)w, and 37 exact tests vM^kQ(M)w=0 imply every further test by Cayley-Hamilton.
